plan.summary: Corrections from Dots' Oct 19 audit of the Gemini addendum, each checked at its primary source: The Cottage moves from its $6M Form D maximum to the $4,108,500 the filing says it capitalized at; Mrs. Doubtfire's note stops saying no outcome was reported (Broadway Journal: closed at a loss); John Proctor Is the Villain is marked Did Not Recoup on BroadwayWorld's Jul 17, 2026 statement; Proof's source and note give the filing's $5.5M minimum. Old values read from the live demo pages on 2026-10-19.
steps: The Cottage capitalization and source from the Form D/A
John Proctor recouped, source, designation, basis and notes

actions.description: The Form D/A says the offering capitalized at $4,108,500; $6M was the maximum.

actions.oldValue: SEC Form D/A filing (Cottage Play Ltd Liability Co, CIK 0001961857, filed Jul 26, 2023): total offering amount $6,000,000 ($4,108,500 sold by then). Matched to the show by its related persons Victoria Lang, Andrew Bogner and Tracey McFarland (Broadway & Beyond Theatricals) and Cornice Productions, the lead producers. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1961857/000196185723000002/xslFormDX01/primary_doc.xml
actions.newValue: SEC Form D/A filing (Cottage Play Ltd Liability Co, CIK 0001961857, filed Jul 26, 2023): "Maximum capitalization was $6,000,000/Minimum capitalization was $4,000,000 - Offering capitalized at $4,108,500" (total amount sold $4,108,500). Matched to the show by its related persons Victoria Lang, Andrew Bogner and Tracey McFarland (Broadway & Beyond Theatricals) and Cornice Productions, the lead producers. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1961857/000196185723000002/primary_doc.xml
actions.description: Quote the filing's own capitalization statement.

actions.oldValue: Broadway run at the Stephen Sondheim (Dec 2021 to May 2022), paused in early 2022. Capitalized for up to $18M per its SEC filing. No investor outcome reported.
actions.newValue: Broadway run at the Stephen Sondheim (Dec 2021 to May 2022), paused in early 2022. Capitalized for $17M (The New York Times); its SEC filing allowed up to $18M. Broadway Journal reported the run closed at a loss on May 29, 2022.
actions.description: The old note said no investor outcome was reported, but recoupedSource cites the Broadway Journal loss report.
BroadwayWorld (Jul 17, 2026) states it did not recoup.

actions.newValue: BroadwayWorld (Ben Waterhouse, Jul 17, 2026): "John Proctor is the Villain, though it did not recoup its investment" https://www.broadwayworld.com/article/Gen-Z-is-Obsessed-with-Movies-Why-Not-Broadway-20260717

actions.description: Closed without recouping per a cited source; no estimate of the amount returned.
A cited source states the non-recoupment.

actions.oldValue: Commercial production at the Booth, Apr 14 to Sep 7, 2025 (extended three times; seven Tony nominations). Its SEC Form D (Oct 2024) offered $6.7 million; no recoupment announced (not on Broadway News' recoupment list as of Oct 2026).
actions.newValue: Commercial production at the Booth, Apr 14 to Sep 7, 2025 (extended three times; seven Tony nominations). Its SEC Form D (Oct 2024) offered $6.7 million. BroadwayWorld reported in Jul 2026 that it did not recoup its investment.
actions.description: The old note said no recoupment was announced; a source now states it did not recoup.

actions.oldValue: SEC Form D filing (Proof on Broadway Ltd Liability Co, CIK 0002098417, filed Dec 9, 2025). Range: $5M-$6.5M max.
actions.newValue: SEC Form D filing (Proof on Broadway Ltd Liability Co, CIK 0002098417, filed Dec 9, 2025): "The minimum capitalization is $5,500,000; the maximum capitalization is $6,500,000." https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2098417/000209841725000001/primary_doc.xml

actions.oldValue: Revival of David Auburn Pulitzer Prize-winning play. SEC Form D shows $5M min to $6.5M max capitalization (previously reported $9M from social media was incorrect). Limited 16-week run Apr-Jul 2026. Co-produced by Mike Bosner and Thomas Kail.
actions.newValue: Revival of David Auburn Pulitzer Prize-winning play. SEC Form D shows a $5.5M minimum to $6.5M maximum capitalization (a $9M figure from social media was incorrect). Limited 16-week run Apr-Jul 2026. Co-produced by Mike Bosner and Thomas Kail.
actions.description: Correct the minimum to the filing's $5.5M.
